$comment: Playmat's card backs (CARD_BACKS in src/app/ui/cardBack.ts): the player picks one in Settings > Playmat; it shows on every hidden card that has no Career sleeve back. Brown like a classic card back, so a hidden card never melts into the green cloth. After drawing, run `python3 art/fit_cards.py public/card-back/*.webp` to fit each back to the full card.
style: Card backs: one upright card back per cell, front view, perfectly flat and symmetrical (mirror-symmetric left to right, and top to bottom where the design allows, since the back is seen upside down across the table), all the same 5:7 rectangle with slightly rounded corners and straight edges; nothing sticks out past the card's edge. The whole card is ONE flat solid field of warm dark leather-brown accent ink #5a3a22 (printed like a solid letterpress block, with its speckle), with every design element printed in ivory ink on it. Each cell is a DIFFERENT design from one family of card backs for the same game: it must read as a premium, quiet, original card back, never as any existing trading card game's back, so no oval frame around a logo, no five coloured dots, no banner with a word. Each card fills about 90% of its cell's height.
spare: a card back with a thin ivory border and one small ivory diamond in the centre
